evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ; modifies src/httpserver.cpp, src/bitcoin-cli.cpp, and RPC bind/connect handling.
rationale: Adds UNIX domain socket support for the HTTP RPC server and bitcoin-cli, addressing a long-standing request from 2014 (issue #5029). This provides a meaningful security and usability improvement by allowing local callers to rely on filesystem permissions rather than TCP loopback and -rpcallowip.
